planSteps.description: Production safety: Never delete existing data, publish, alter settings, bypass auth, expose credentials/cookies/tokens, or mock a flow. Capture exact actions and sanitized request URL, method, status and relevant response on failures. Open /login; enter nonexistent ff-audit-invalid@example.com and a randomly generated password; click Sign in. Capture sanitized request method, URL, status, response and visible error.
Login returns an authentication error (401/400), displays a helpful error and remains signed out; never 405, HTML, or 5xx.
